metric: official rc-cli score, lower is better, 0 = driver's exact order

timing_note: per-route CPU seconds of one worker process (1 torch thread): zone_order = features + history lookup + model + beam search; solver = OR-Tools inside zones. Scoring is not included. Training times are one-off, 3 torch threads.

settings.in_zone_solver: OR-Tools routing, start at previous stop, end at a dummy node whose cost is the travel time to the nearest stop of the next zone (station after the last zone); PATH_CHEAPEST_ARC + GREEDY_DESCENT
settings.zone_order_target: first visit to each zone in the driver's order
settings.no_zone_stops: attached to the zone of the nearest stop (travel time both ways)
